conditions_to_select2000: Both curves complete and source-stable; identical realized fields/times/roles and training-only normalization verified.
Both ESN tracks have an equal-G1/G3/G4 macro normalized native-CRPS improvement lower bound of at least 0.02.
Every ESN scenario/track cell has at least three common-qualified short/long pairs.
In every ESN scenario/track cell, long-history qualification count is not lower than short-history count.
Long-history summed recorded all-roster pipeline time divided by short-history time is at most 2.5, with complete cost accounting in both conditions.
decision_rule.declared_before: Any history-curve outcome generation or inspection.
decision_rule.interpretation: Exploratory development resource/specification selection. The 0.02 margin and 2.5 cost ratio are explicit practical preferences, not universal thresholds. Small-sample percentile bounds do not establish formal coverage or simultaneous scientific superiority. Native cells condition on pairwise qualification, so the all-field operational results and qualification counts must accompany them. Insufficient pairs or any other failed gate retain 1000 with a recorded reason; that is not evidence of no data benefit. Report every model's paired effects regardless of this ESN-centered choice. Do not use confirmation observations to revisit the rule.
report_populations: Native CRPS for every compatible probabilistic model, conditional on each short/long qualified intersection.
Native RMSE for every compatible model, conditional on each short/long qualified intersection.
Operational RMSE for every compatible model, using all five completed paired fields per mechanism including declared fallbacks.

retention_reasons: Both ESN tracks did not establish the declared practical improvement lower bound
scientific_interpretation: Exploratory development resource/specification choice. Native effects condition on pairwise qualification. Retaining 1000 with insufficient evidence is not a finding of no data benefit; no formal coverage or simultaneous superiority is established.
score_bounds_definition: Both ESN tracks: lower one-sided95 bound for normalized native CRPS(1000)-CRPS(2000) >=0.02 with sufficient pairs
